2607.28137.title: Asymmetric Communication: Large Language Models and Language Games
2607.28137.paper_summary: Contemporary AI discourse attributes to language models properties they cannot bear: general intelligence as substrate-independent cognition, hallucination as cognitive failure, agency as autonomous goal-pursuit, sentience as emergent inner life, alignment as goal synchronization. This paper argues that these are instances of a single category mistake--properties constituted within human communicative practice are projected onto the machine side--and explains its structure. Human-LLM interaction constitutes a language game in which one side bears all normative activity. We call this configuration asymmetric communication since model outputs circulate communicatively, entering further exchanges, without the system undertaking commitments, bearing entitlements, or performing the assessment on which discursive standing depends. Three conditions define the asymmetry: (i) correctness is enforced exclusively by the receiver; (ii) accountability is borne by human participants alone; and (iii) the practical standing of any output depends entirely on human uptake. These conditions are structural, hold independently of capability, and remain unchanged as more powerful models raise the stakes of misattribution. The framework draws on Wittgenstein (meaning enacted in shared practices), Luhmann (communication completed on the receiver's side), Esposito (algorithmic contingency sufficient for uptake), and Brandom (normative scorekeeping as the source of discursive standing). Applied to all five, it reclassifies each as a receiver-side phenomenon, grounds guardrails as structural necessities rather than manifestations of machine moral agency, and yields an implication for AI governance. Alignment is institutional constraint engineering, not goal synchronization between agents, while responsibility remains with human institutions.
2607.28137.paper_summary_zh: 當代的人工智慧論述將語言模型賦予它們無法承擔的特性：作為基底獨立認知的一般智能、作為認知失敗的幻覺、作為自主目標追求的能動性、作為新興內在生活的感知、作為目標同步的對齊。本文主張這些都是單一類別錯誤的實例——在人的交際實踐中構成的特性被投射到機器一側——並解釋其結構。人類與大型語言模型的互動構成了一種語言遊戲，其中一方承擔所有的規範活動。我們稱這種配置為不對稱溝通，因為模型輸出在交際中循環，進入進一步的交流，而系統並未承擔承諾、承擔權利或進行依賴於話語地位的評估。三個條件定義了不對稱性：（i）正確性僅由接收者強制執行；（ii）問責制僅由人類參與者承擔；（iii）任何輸出的實際地位完全依賴於人類的接受。這些條件是結構性的，獨立於能力，並在更強大的模型提高錯誤歸因的風險時保持不變。該框架借鑒了維根斯坦（在共享實踐中實現的意義）、盧曼（在接收者一側完成的溝通）、埃斯波西托（足夠的算法偶然性以便接受）和布蘭登（作為話語地位來源的規範記分）。將這五者應用於所有情境，它重新將每一個重新分類為接收者一側的現象，將護欄作為結構必要性而非機器道德能動性的表現，並為人工智慧治理帶來啟示。對齊是制度約束工程，而非代理之間的目標同步，同時責任仍然在於人類機構。
